item.title: Missouri State Highway Patrol reports 10 fatal crashes during 2025 Christmas holiday
item.description: The Missouri State Highway Patrol reported 10 deaths, 258 traffic crashes, 94 injuries, and 93 DWI arrests during the 2025 Christmas holiday period.

item.title: Frigid air flees as we move into 2026
item.description: A warming trend will begin on Tuesday, with temperatures rising above freezing and mild weather continuing through the weekend and into early next week.

item.title: Shell Knob woman dies in fatal Barry County crash
item.description: A 74-year-old woman was killed and a 45-year-old man was seriously injured in a crash near Golden, Missouri on Saturday, Dec. 27.

item.title: Second man arrested in string of burglaries in Polk County
item.description: Skyler Johnson, 19, was arrested and charged with nine felonies, including four counts of second-degree burglary, three counts of felony stealing, and two counts of first-degree property damage, in connection with multiple burglaries in Polk County, Missouri, which resulted in an estimated $25,796.08 in stolen items and $5,400 in property damage.

item.title: Air travelers make final flights home before start of New Year's
item.description: Travelers at the Springfield-Branson National Airport experienced both enjoyable experiences and delays as they returned home from their holiday celebrations, with many sharing their New Year's resolutions.

item.title: Springfield police says 17-year-old died in fatal single-vehicle crash
item.description: A single-vehicle crash in Springfield Saturday night resulted in the death of the driver, who was ejected from the vehicle after it struck a guardrail.

item.title: Person dies after crash that damaged Zaxby's in Springfield
item.description: A man died after a collision at a Zaxby's in south Springfield on Monday afternoon, after suffering a possible medical event while driving a red truck which crashed into a white SUV and then into the restaurant.
